description: One modifier in full: its choices with prices and defaults, and every category it is linked to with that category’s own rules. Read this before editing — update_modifier REPLACES the whole choice list, so you need the current one to send back. Each choice carries price (formatted, for reading out) and priceAmount (plain, what the write tools accept back). Pass priceAmount, never price.
name: hub_get_modifier
title: Get modifier
